description: This file defines API handlers for file operations in Mattermost, including uploading, retrieving, thumbnailing, linking, previewing, and searching files. It handles multipart uploads, permission checks, plugin hooks, and public link generation.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Struct representing the API handlers for file operations.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object used in request handling, containing request, response, app, and session info.

methods.name: InitFile
methods.description: Initializes the file-related API routes and handlers.

methods.name: parseMultipartRequestHeader
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header to extract the multipart boundary.

methods.name: multipartReader
methods.description: Creates a multipart.Reader from the request or stream.

methods.name: uploadFileStream
methods.description: Handles streaming file uploads, supporting multipart and simple uploads.

methods.name: uploadFileSimple
methods.description: Uploads a file from a simple POST request with the file in the body.

methods.name: uploadFileMultipart
methods.description: Parses and uploads files from a multipart request, supporting streaming and re-processing.

methods.name: uploadFileMultipartLegacy
methods.description: Legacy support for multipart uploads, buffering entire form before processing.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves and streams a file to the client, with permission and plugin hook checks.

methods.name: getFileThumbnail
methods.description: Streams a file's thumbnail, with permission and plugin hook checks.

methods.name: getFileLink
methods.description: Generates and returns a public link for a file if enabled and permitted.

methods.name: getFilePreview
methods.description: Streams a file's preview image, with permission and plugin hook checks.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about a file, with permission checks.

methods.name: getPublicFile
methods.description: Streams a publicly accessible file after hash validation.

methods.name: searchFilesInTeam
methods.description: Searches files within a specific team, with permission checks.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Performs file search with parameters, returning results and audit info.

methods.name: setInaccessibleFileHeader
methods.description: Sets headers indicating inaccessible files due to cloud plan limits.
